tips.text: Stockpile Polymer Bundle and Gallium before the event starts so you can craft Ciphers on day one.
Run the Razorback solo or paired to keep the Cipher cost down.
Do the three bonus-reward completions early in the event for the credits and Orokin Catalyst on top of the part rolls.
Expect the Razorback fight to be easy and the Cipher economy to be what hurts.
Expect the wait for the next Armada to be the most common complaint; once it is live the set takes about a dozen runs.
